```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 17_correlation_calculate_r
title: >
  Calculate r
questions:
  - id: calculate_r
    type: numeric
    prompt: >
      If $SP = 15$, $SS_X = 30$, and $SS_Y = 10$, what is Pearson's r?
    answer: 0.87
    tolerance: 0.02
    explanation: >
      $r = SP / sqrt(SS_X SS_Y) = 15 / sqrt(300) = 0.87$.
```
